name: Coconut Secret Organic Raw Coconut Aminos (Soy-Free & Low Sodium)
whyItWorks: Made from naturally fermented coconut palm blossom sap and sea salt. It contains NO coconut meat or fiber, is 100% soy-free, 100% gluten-free, and has 73% less sodium than soy sauce. Gentle, sweet, and soothing on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle freely over rice bowls, chicken, or salmon.
watchOuts: Made from liquid tree sap; completely free of woody coconut fibers.
